const {test}=require('node:test'),assert=require('node:assert/strict')
const {harness,id,redirected,render}=require('./helpers/finance-operations.cjs')
const author='../elearning/assessments/actions.ts',learner='../../learn/assessments/actions.ts'
const valid={action:'CREATE',version:id(2),title:'Synthetic',kind:'FINAL',threshold:'70',question_ids:'1','q.1.points':'1','q.1.type':'TRUE_FALSE','q.1.mode':'AUTO','q.1.prompt':'Synthetic question','q.1.key':'true'}
test('assessment authoring denies non-admin before mutation',async()=>{const h=harness({},null,false);const url=await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,valid);assert.equal(url.pathname,'/login');assert.equal(h.calls.length,1)})
test('final authoring preserves approved limits and configured threshold',async()=>{const h=harness();await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{...valid,threshold:'80',limit:'999',cooldown:'0'});assert.deepEqual(h.calls.at(-1).args,{p_version:id(2),p_title:'Synthetic',p_kind:'FINAL',p_threshold:80,p_limit:3,p_cooldown:86400,p_questions:[{code:'Q1',type:'TRUE_FALSE',mode:'AUTO',prompt:'Synthetic question',points:1,options:[],key:true}]})})
test('unsupported notation cannot be advertised as AUTO',async()=>{const h=harness();const u=await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{...valid,'q.1.type':'NOTE_PLACEMENT'});assert.equal(u.searchParams.get('error'),'manual');assert.equal(h.calls.length,1)})
test('approval never accepts forged reviewer identity',async()=>{const h=harness();await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{action:'APPROVE',id:id(2),reason:'Reviewed',reviewer:id(9)});assert.deepEqual(h.calls.at(-1),{rpc:'approve_learning_assessment',args:{p_id:id(2),p_reason:'Reviewed'}})})
test('manual review sends marks not client-computed final score',async()=>{const h=harness();await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{action:'REVIEW',id:id(2),'mark.Q1':'2',score:'100',reason:'Evidence checked'});assert.deepEqual(h.calls.at(-1),{rpc:'review_learning_assessment',args:{p_attempt:id(2),p_marks:{Q1:2},p_reason:'Evidence checked'}})})
test('anonymous student cannot start assessment',async()=>{const h=harness({},null,false,false);const u=await redirected(h.load(learner).startAssessment,{assessment:id(2),request:id(3),identity:'on'});assert.equal(u.pathname,'/login');assert.equal(h.calls.length,0)})
test('start uses canonical identity and attempt cap from database',async()=>{const h=harness();await redirected(h.load(learner).startAssessment,{assessment:id(2),request:id(3),identity:'on',student:id(9),limit:'999'});assert.deepEqual(h.calls.at(-1),{rpc:'start_learning_assessment',args:{p_id:id(2),p_request:id(3),p_identity_confirmed:true}})})
test('submission uses protected snapshot and ignores forged question type/score',async()=>{const h=harness({learning_assessment_attempts:[{id:id(2),question_snapshot:[{code:'Q1',type:'TRUE_FALSE',mode:'AUTO'}]}]});await redirected(h.load(learner).submitAssessment,{attempt:id(2),'answer.Q1':'false','answer.FORGED':'true',score:'100',student:id(9)});assert.deepEqual(h.calls.at(-1),{rpc:'submit_learning_assessment',args:{p_attempt:id(2),p_answers:{Q1:false}}})})
test('expiry preventing snapshot read prevents submission RPC',async()=>{const h=harness();const u=await redirected(h.load(learner).submitAssessment,{attempt:id(2),'answer.Q1':'true'});assert.equal(u.searchParams.get('error'),'assessment');assert.ok(!h.calls.some(c=>c.rpc==='submit_learning_assessment'))})
test('manual queue displays database overdue flag and private rubric to admin',async()=>{const h=harness({learning_assessments:[{id:id(3),questions:[{code:'Q1',rubric:'Synthetic rubric'}]}],learning_manual_review_queue:[{id:id(2),student_id:id(4),assessment_id:id(3),submitted_at:'2026-09-16T00:00:00Z',review_due_at:'2026-09-18T00:00:00Z',overdue:true,question_snapshot:[{code:'Q1',mode:'MANUAL',prompt:'Synthetic prompt',points:4}],answers:{Q1:'Response'}}]});const html=await render(h,'../elearning/assessments');assert.match(html,/Quá hạn, cần xử lý/);assert.match(html,/Synthetic rubric/);assert.ok(h.calls.some(c=>c.table==='learning_manual_review_queue'))})
test('notation submission strips forged fields and stores structured music',async()=>{const h=harness({learning_assessment_attempts:[{id:id(2),question_snapshot:[{code:'Q1',type:'NOTE_PLACEMENT',mode:'MANUAL'}]}]});const music={schema:1,clef:'treble',fifths:0,time:{beats:4,unit:4},measures:[{partial:true,events:[{id:'a',kind:'NOTE',pitches:[{step:'C',octave:4,alter:0}],denominator:4,dots:0,stem:'AUTO'}],beams:[],tuplets:[]}],relations:[],score:100};await redirected(h.load(learner).submitAssessment,{attempt:id(2),'answer.Q1':JSON.stringify(music)});assert.equal(h.calls.at(-1).args.p_answers.Q1.schema,1);assert.equal(h.calls.at(-1).args.p_answers.Q1.score,undefined)})
test('invalid notation cannot be submitted as valid structured response',async()=>{const h=harness({learning_assessment_attempts:[{id:id(2),question_snapshot:[{code:'Q1',type:'NOTE_PLACEMENT',mode:'MANUAL'}]}]});const url=await redirected(h.load(learner).submitAssessment,{attempt:id(2),'answer.Q1':'{"schema":1,"score":100}'});assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('error'),'1');assert.ok(!h.calls.some(c=>c.rpc==='submit_learning_assessment'))})
test('regrade submits revision and idempotency key, never a caller supplied final score',async()=>{const h=harness();await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{action:'REGRADE',id:id(2),request:id(3),revision:id(4),'mark.Q2':'1',score:'100',reason:'Corrected rubric application'});assert.deepEqual(h.calls.at(-1),{rpc:'regrade_learning_assessment',args:{p_attempt:id(2),p_request:id(3),p_expected_revision:id(4),p_marks:{Q2:1},p_reason:'Corrected rubric application'}})})
test('regrade rejects invalid optimistic revision before mutation',async()=>{const h=harness();const url=await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{action:'REGRADE',id:id(2),request:id(3),revision:'forged','mark.Q2':'1',reason:'Correction'});assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('error'),'invalid');assert.equal(h.calls.length,1)})
test('multi-question authoring preserves ordered stable codes and separate manual rubric',async()=>{const h=harness();await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{...valid,question_ids:'1,3','q.3.type':'TRIAD_CONSTRUCTION','q.3.mode':'MANUAL','q.3.points':'3','q.3.prompt':'Synthetic triad','q.3.rubric':'Synthetic rubric','q.3.key':'forged','q.2.prompt':'removed question'});const questions=h.calls.at(-1).args.p_questions;assert.equal(questions.length,2);assert.equal(questions[0].key,true);assert.deepEqual(questions[1],{code:'Q3',type:'TRIAD_CONSTRUCTION',mode:'MANUAL',prompt:'Synthetic triad',points:3,options:[],rubric:'Synthetic rubric'});assert.ok(!questions.some(q=>q.code==='Q2'))})
test('duplicate, empty, malformed or excessive question lists fail before RPC',async()=>{for(const question_ids of ['','1,1','0','1,__proto__',Array.from({length:101},(_,i)=>i+1).join(',')]){const h=harness();const url=await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{...valid,question_ids});assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('error'),'invalid');assert.ok(!h.calls.some(c=>c.rpc==='create_learning_assessment'))}})
test('every manual question requires a rubric before creating the draft',async()=>{const h=harness();const url=await redirected(h.load(author).assessmentAdminAction,{...valid,question_ids:'1,2','q.2.type':'COMPOSITION','q.2.mode':'MANUAL','q.2.points':'2','q.2.prompt':'Synthetic composition'});assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('error'),'invalid');assert.ok(!h.calls.some(c=>c.rpc==='create_learning_assessment'))})
test('assessment author page exposes repeatable question controls and per-question rubric fields',async()=>{const html=await render(harness(),'../elearning/assessments');assert.match(html,/Thêm câu hỏi/);assert.match(html,/name="question_ids"/);assert.match(html,/name="q.1.prompt"/);assert.match(html,/name="q.1.rubric"/)})

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports */
const {test}=require('node:test'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),fs=require('node:fs'),ts=require('typescript')
const m={exports:{}}
new Function('module','exports',ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync('lib/learning/notation.ts','utf8'),{compilerOptions:{module:ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS,target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022}}).outputText)(m,m.exports)
const {parseNotation,parsePitch,pitchText,initialNotation,eventDuration,measureDuration,notationText}=m.exports
const fixture=()=>structuredClone(initialNotation),note=(id,pitch='C4',denominator=4,dots=0)=>({id,kind:'NOTE',pitches:[parsePitch(pitch)],denominator,dots,stem:'AUTO'})
test('notation retains pitch spelling instead of equating enharmonic notes',()=>{assert.notDeepEqual(parsePitch('C#4'),parsePitch('Db4'));assert.equal(pitchText(parsePitch('Bb3')),'Bb3')})
test('notation rejects arbitrary pitch strings and out of range octave',()=>{for(const p of ['H4','C9','C-1','<script>'])assert.throws(()=>parsePitch(p))})
test('dotted and double dotted durations are exact fractions',()=>{assert.deepEqual(eventDuration(note('a','C4',4,1)),{n:3,d:8});assert.deepEqual(eventDuration(note('a','C4',4,2)),{n:7,d:16})})
test('triplet group totals exactly one quarter note',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events=['a','b','c'].map(i=>note(i,'C4',8));s.measures[0].tuplets=[{ids:['a','b','c'],actual:3,normal:2}];const v=parseNotation(s);assert.deepEqual(measureDuration(v.measures[0]),{n:1,d:4})})
test('duplet group totals exactly a dotted quarter',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events=['a','b'].map(i=>note(i,'C4',8));s.measures[0].tuplets=[{ids:['a','b'],actual:2,normal:3}];assert.deepEqual(measureDuration(parseNotation(s).measures[0]),{n:3,d:8})})
test('incomplete and overfull measures do not silently pass duration validation',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].partial=false;assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s));s.measures[0].partial=true;s.measures[0].events=[note('a','C4',1,1)];assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s))})
test('complete common time measure accepts four crotchets',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].partial=false;s.measures[0].events=['a','b','c','d'].map(i=>note(i));assert.doesNotThrow(()=>parseNotation(s))})
test('rest has duration but cannot carry a pitch',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events[0].kind='REST';assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s));s.measures[0].events[0].pitches=[];assert.equal(parseNotation(s).measures[0].events[0].kind,'REST')})
test('duplicate ids and overlapping tuplets are rejected',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events=[note('a','C4',8),note('b','C4',8),note('c','C4',8)];s.measures[0].tuplets=[{ids:['a','b','c'],actual:3,normal:2},{ids:['a','b','c'],actual:3,normal:2}];assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s));s.measures[0].tuplets=[];s.measures[0].events[1].id='a';assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s))})
test('beams require adjacent short notes and exclude rests',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events=[note('a','C4',8),note('b','D4',8),note('c','E4',8)];s.measures[0].beams=[['a','c']];assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s));s.measures[0].beams=[['a','b']];assert.doesNotThrow(()=>parseNotation(s));s.measures[0].events[0].kind='REST';s.measures[0].events[0].pitches=[];assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s))})
test('ties require identical written pitches in consecutive events',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events=[note('a','C#4'),note('b','Db4')];s.relations=[{kind:'TIE',from:'a',to:'b'}];assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s));s.measures[0].events[1]=note('b','C#4');assert.doesNotThrow(()=>parseNotation(s))})
test('slur permits different pitches without treating them as tied duration',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events=[note('a','C4'),note('b','G4')];s.relations=[{kind:'SLUR',from:'a',to:'b'}];assert.deepEqual(measureDuration(parseNotation(s).measures[0]),{n:1,d:2})})
test('triad spelling is canonicalized without changing pitch identity',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events[0].pitches=['G4','C4','E4'].map(parsePitch);assert.deepEqual(parseNotation(s).measures[0].events[0].pitches.map(pitchText),['C4','E4','G4'])})
test('unsupported clefs and malformed schema fail closed',()=>{const s=fixture();s.clef='alto';assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s));s.clef='treble';s.schema=2;assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s));assert.throws(()=>parseNotation({}))})
test('payload is bounded and unknown scoring fields are discarded',()=>{const s=fixture();s.score=100;s.key='secret';const parsed=parseNotation(s);assert.equal(parsed.score,undefined);assert.equal(parsed.key,undefined);s.measures=Array(9).fill(s.measures[0]);assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s))})
test('notation has readable pitch duration clef and meter alternative',()=>{const s=fixture();s.clef='bass';assert.match(notationText(parseNotation(s)),/Khóa Fa, nhịp 4\/4/);assert.match(notationText(parseNotation(s)),/C4, 1\/4/)})
test('beamed notes cannot request contradictory stem directions',()=>{const s=fixture();s.measures[0].events=[{...note('a','C4',8),stem:'UP'},{...note('b','E4',8),stem:'DOWN'}];s.measures[0].beams=[['a','b']];assert.throws(()=>parseNotation(s));s.measures[0].events[1].stem='AUTO';assert.doesNotThrow(()=>parseNotation(s))})
